conflicts.permit: We may only process the data of children under 13 if there is a consent of his parent/guardian for the use of our Services.
conflicts.prohibit: The Services Libra provides are not directed towards children under 13 (under 16 for children located in the European Economic Area and under 14 for children located in South Korea) and we do not collect or demand data from anyone under 13.
conflicts.situation: Collecting or processing data from a child under 13 whose parent or guardian has provided consent.
conflicts.reason: The policy flatly prohibits collecting data from anyone under 13, yet simultaneously allows processing their data if parental/guardian consent is provided.
